verdict.rationale: Bento documents bulk subscriber import through the `/batch/subscribers` API and CLI CSV import. Its docs state that tags and custom fields can be set via imports, and pricing promises migration help when switching, with users reporting moves from Mailchimp and HubSpot. However, nothing shows a guided, platform-specific import flow or that unsubscribe state carries over on import. Missing for 10: guided in-app import wizard or source-platform connectors, documented preservation of unsubscribe/suppression status on import, hands-on corroboration of a migration preserving tags and fields.
